name: TwoStepView
summary: A rendering in two stages: the data becomes a logical page, and the logical page becomes the output.

roles.name: TwoStepView
roles.summary: A view that produces an intermediate, presentation-neutral structure before any markup exists. The whole of its value is the second step being written once: a global change to the look is one change, not one per screen — and the price is a layer that must express everything every screen needs.
